card.architecture: BiRefNet single-image matte (BiRefNetMatte node, ZhengPeng7/BiRefNet via transformers) — LoadImage → BiRefNetMatte → SaveImage (PNG, alpha)
card.summary: Removes the background from a single image with BiRefNet and outputs a transparent-background PNG. The still sibling of birefnet-matte-video, for per-frame callers (e.g. keying an individually re-pixelized sprite frame where there is no clip to matte). No checkpoint — the node loads its own model.
use_cases: cut a character frame out of its (white) background into a transparent PNG
per-frame background removal for the sprite export pipeline
card.pick_when: You have a single image and want its background removed (transparent alpha).
